Metadata.homeDescription: Predict or simulate every remaining match of the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1 and Brasileirão, and watch the table update live.
Metadata.leagueDescription: Simulate the rest of the {league} {season} season: enter your own scores or let the simulator play them, then see title, Europe and relegation chances.

Home.heading: Simulate the season before it happens
Home.subheading: Pick a league, enter your predictions or let the simulator play the remaining matches, and watch the table change live.
Home.featurePredictBody: Type any score for any match. The table and tiebreakers update instantly.
Home.featureSimulateBody: Results are drawn from each team's attack and defence this season, with home advantage.
Home.featureChancesBody: 10,000 simulated seasons show the odds of the title, Europe and relegation.

Simulator.resetConfirm: Clear all your predictions for this league?
Simulator.sampleBanner: Sample data: these teams and results are generated. Set FOOTBALL_DATA_API_KEY to load the real season.
Simulator.liveSource: Real fixtures and results, updated hourly
Simulator.basedOn: Based on {count} simulated seasons from the current table, including your predictions.
